# GCP (Google Kubernetes Engine)

This directory contains all GCP-specific code for deploying a GKE cluster with Kasten K10 data protection.

* [k8s-tf/](./k8s-tf): Terraform code to provision a GKE cluster, VPC, GCS, Secret Manager, and optionally bootstrap ArgoCD with GitOps-managed applications.
* [argocd/](./argocd): ArgoCD application and addon manifests. The majority of these files are auto-generated by Terraform.
